div.div: Connections: every service reads/writes MongoDB (its own collections only), uses Redis, and produces/consumes Kafka (through its outbox relay). document-svc and media-worker write to the file volume, which nginx serves. Prometheus scrapes every service and exporter. See diagram 03 for who talks to whom.
